short_description: Copy FSLogix admx\adml files and Create new GPO
description:
Team,
In order to setup a FSLogix profile management for domain users in an AVD, we need following setup on domain level.
Please  import the FSLogix ADMX\ADML templates into the domain policy definitions folder. Additionally, please create a new Group Policy Object (GPO) and link it to our DHCF AVD Organizational Unit.

Actions Required:
1. Copy ADMX/ADML files:
• Copy fslogix.admx to:
\\dcgov.pciv\SYSVOL\dcgov.priv\Policies\PolicyDefinitionsFSLogix
• Copy fslogix.adml to:
\\dcgov.pciv\SYSVOL\dcgov.priv\Policies\PolicyDefinitions\en-US

2. Create and link a new GPO to the following OU:
OU=Azure VD,OU=DHCF Azure,OU=DHCF,DC=dcgov,DC=priv

3. Configure the following GPO settings under:
Computer Configuration ? Administrative Templates ? FSLogix ? Profile Containers
• Enable FSLogix Profile Container: Enabled
• VHDLocations:\\dhcfdavdintfslsaeu01.file.core.windows.net\dhcf-dev-avd-userprofile-fs-01
VHDLocations Type change to multistring 'REG_MULTI_SZ' not REG_SZ ,
• Access network as computer object: Disabled not Enabled

LockedRetryCount    DWORD	3	Recommended

LockedRetryInterval  DWORD	15	Recommended

ProfileType     DWORD	0	Default

ReAttachIntervalSeconds    DWORD	15	Recommended

ReAttachRetryCount     DWORD	3	Recommended

SizeInMBs	DWORD	30000	   Default

PreventLoginWithTempProfile    DWORD     1

PreventLoginWithFailure                DWORD    1


• Delete local profile when VHD should apply: Enabled
• Capture username on profile management in storage: Enabled

4. Configure container and directory naming settings under:
Computer Configuration ? Administrative Templates ? FSLogix ? Profile Containers ? Container and Directory Naming
• Flip Flop Profile Directory: Enabled
• Volume Type: VHDX

Please let me know if you need any further details or clarification

description:
Team,
In order to setup a FSLogix profile management for domain users in an AVD, we need following setup on domain level.
Please  import the FSLogix ADMX\ADML templates into the domain policy definitions folder. Additionally, please create a new Group Policy Object (GPO) and link it to our DHCF AVD Organizational Unit.

Actions Required:
1. Copy ADMX/ADML files:
• Copy fslogix.admx to:
\\dcgov.pciv\SYSVOL\dcgov.priv\Policies\PolicyDefinitionsFSLogix
• Copy fslogix.adml to:
\\dcgov.pciv\SYSVOL\dcgov.priv\Policies\PolicyDefinitions\en-US

2. Create and link a new GPO to the following OU:
OU=Azure VD,OU=DHCF Azure,OU=DHCF,DC=dcgov,DC=priv

3. Configure the following GPO settings under:
Computer Configuration ? Administrative Templates ? FSLogix ? Profile Containers
• Enable FSLogix Profile Container: Enabled
• VHDLocations:\\dhcfdavdintfslsaeu01.file.core.windows.net\dhcf-dev-avd-userprofile-fs-01
VHDLocations Type change to multistring 'REG_MULTI_SZ' not REG_SZ ,
• Access network as computer object: Disabled not Enabled

LockedRetryCount    DWORD	3	Recommended

LockedRetryInterval  DWORD	15	Recommended

ProfileType     DWORD	0	Default

ReAttachIntervalSeconds    DWORD	15	Recommended

ReAttachRetryCount     DWORD	3	Recommended

SizeInMBs	DWORD	30000	Default


• Delete local profile when VHD should apply: Enabled
• Capture username on profile management in storage: Enabled

4. Configure container and directory naming settings under:
Computer Configuration ? Administrative Templates ? FSLogix ? Profile Containers ? Container and Directory Naming
• Flip Flop Profile Directory: Enabled
• Volume Type: VHDX

Please let me know if you need any further details or clarification

Good morning, OCTO Team,

The Office of Employee Appeals (OEA) is a small independent agency without dedicated on-site IT support. As Chief Operating Officer, I frequently handle operational and basic IT support tasks for agency staff before escalating unresolved issues to the OCTO HelpDesk.

To better serve our team and reduce downtime, I kindly request administrative rights for my login access. This would allow me to assist OEA staff with daily common IT issues, such as network connectivity problems or basic system troubleshooting. Recently, for example, a staff member accidentally disabled her laptop’s internet connection, resulting in a prolonged period of downtime until OCTO could resolve the issue. With admin rights, I could have addressed this quickly, minimizing the delay and improving our internal support efficiency.

Granting me these permissions will ensure smoother, faster resolution of minor issues, reducing dependency on the HelpDesk for simple fixes and enhancing service continuity for our staff.

Thank you for considering this request. If you need further information or want to discuss this, please contact me or Director Barfield.

Best regards,

It’s a pleasure serving you.

short_description: Need a new local Host (Windows/Unix) for setting up MID Server for ServiceNow Integration
description:
As part of ServiceNow ITSM implementation, we need to setup a MID server within DC Network that will be used by specialized integrations (out-of-box spokes) to be deployed for our Multi-Source CMDB approach and integrations with other on-premise systems as explained below.

For integrating with external applications, ServiceNow (SN) offers the following three different approaches:
Standard Web services (API) based integration - Used to integrate SN with other cloud applications like Azure AD (currently used for SSO data sync-up between Azure AD and SN).
MID Server based integration - Used to integrate SN with any on-premise applications / systems that runs within our local network (behind the firewall).
Out of the box connectors (also known as IntegrationHub Spokes) - Spokes offer predefined, instant integration with known applications and it internally use either API or MID server approach only.
MID Server stands for Management, Instrumentation and Discovery server and it is a Java application that can be installed on a Windows or Linux Server and used as a Windows Service or Unix daemon in the local network, to facilitate a secure communication channel between ServiceNow and on-premise applications running within our local network.

Towards this, I need help in setting up a Windows or Linux Server where we can install a separate MID server for communication with our DEV, UAT/Test and Production instances of ServiceNow. In addition, need a technical resource who can assist with the installation of the MID server. SN offers a detailed step-by-step installation guide (link below) and also, we get necessary support from New Rocket for the installation.

https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/rome-servicenow-platform/page/product/mid-server/concept/mid-server-installation.html Note: To meet high security standards, the MID Server performs x.509 certificate validation on HTTPS traffic when connecting to ServiceNow®

Please arrange for the necessary assistance in securing the Windows/Linux Server and a suitable technical resource to help with the installation. Thank you!

short_description: Setup AWS Security Health Improvement Program in LZ Environment
description:
Please setup AWS Security Health Improvement Program in LZ Environment to run periodic scan on the infrastructure-

Here are the more details of SHIP, an email also attached to this ticket for more details and links to github and AWS documentation.

What is SHIP?
The Security Health Improvement Program (SHIP) is a no-cost program available to all AWS customers that helps improve AWS security health by:
•	Highlighting AWS security best practices
•	Accelerating adoption of core AWS security use cases
•	Conducting security checks and prioritizing findings
•	Delivering prescriptive recommendations to resolve findings
•	Mapping native AWS Security Services and Partner offerings to core security use cases
•	Providing resources and programs for continuous security improvement
How SHIP Works:
The program follows a structured three-step engagement process:
1.	Discovery Meeting - Align on your security use cases and priorities (45 minutes)
2.	Assessment & Analysis - Deploy security assessment tools and gather insights (24 hours for data collection)
3.	Delivery Meeting - Review findings, insights, and recommendations with an actionable roadmap (60 minutes)
Setup and Implementation Steps:
To implement SHIP in our AWS LZ environment, we'll need to:
1.	Initial Engagement
o	Schedule kickoff discovery meeting to align on security priorities
2.	Assessment Deployment
o	Deploy the self-service Security Assessment Tool (SATv2) (https://github.com/awslabs/aws-security-assessment-solution)
o	Allow 24 hours for automated data gathering across our AWS accounts
3.	Review & Analysis
o	Analyze findings across nine foundational security use cases:
?	Threat Detection (Amazon GuardDuty)
?	Risk Correlation & Analytics (AWS Security Hub)
?	Permissions Analysis (IAM Access Analyzer)
?	Application Firewall (AWS WAF)
?	Vulnerability Management (Amazon Inspector)
?	Key Management (AWS KMS)
?	Credentials Protection (AWS Secrets Manager)
?	Network Protection (AWS Network Firewall)
?	Configuration Monitoring (AWS Config)
4.	Roadmap Development
o	Receive customized SHIP HealthCheck presentation
o	Develop prioritized security improvement roadmap
o	Identify immediate remediation opportunities
Request & Timeline:
We would like to request your support in coordinating this SHIP engagement for DC's AWS environment. Ideally, we'd like to complete the initial setup and discovery meeting by next week per Teddy's request. The total time commitment is approximately 2 hours of meeting time plus the automated assessment period.
Once the assessment is complete and we receive the findings, our AWS team will work closely with you to:
•	Review the comprehensive security posture report
•	Discuss prescriptive recommendations for identified gaps
•	Develop an actionable mitigation strategy for any identified risks
•	Prioritize security improvements based on business impact
Next Steps:
Please let us know your availability for an initial kickoff discussion. If you have any questions about the program or need additional information, I'm happy to schedule a brief call to discuss further.
You can learn more about SHIP at: https://aws.amazon.com/security/security_start_right_run_well/

short_description: DCRB DNS verification
description:
We have had an issue with a user and a application taking a very long delay before finishing. After looking into every other possible option, are leaning towards a possible DNS issue. 

Brief overview: We are using GP for Financial stuff. The team that uses this is about 8 users. Of those, a few weeks ago one user reported this issue but after giving temp admin rights, it went away. This user, Rhonda O'Neal had it happen a week later and admin rights did not fix it. We tried everything we could think of and worked with a vendor for the program and still got no where. It seems to be profile based but is not directly causing it. Both of those users had it happen after the latest patch applied to office. What we have discovered is when the user hits this one button, and this one function only (rest of the application works perfectly), it stalls for 6 minutes trying to resolve a system name. What we dont know yet is if this is occurring from client to server, or server return to client. But since all other functions are working fine, think this one is calling a system and is not using the FQDN or something along those lines. So it gets stalled for the 6 minutes or so, and then ends up resolving the correct way and the function will complete for th euser. BUT that program is in "not responsive" mode during that whiole time and not usable. It should be like a 15 second delay, not 7-10mins.

So, the main reason for this ticket is to see what DNS entries DCRB has in the dcgov domain as we are still in the middle of migrating domains. All users and workstations are on the dcgov and the servers are still on the dcrb.local for the time being. (i think for some reason the client is using the OCTO dns and not the DCRB, even with a host file on the users system defining these servers) and somewhere along the path cant find its way.

The servers in question are (and remember they are all on the dcrb.local domain still so fqdn ends in .dcrb.local):
DCRBFMSAPP01P - 10.83.181. 53
DCRBFMSAPP02P - 10.83.181.55
DCRBFMSSQL01P - 10.83.181.56
DCRBFMSWEB01P - 10.83.181.54
DCRBKTAPP01P - 10.83.181.57

I can be reached for additional answers or anything needing to be cleared up.

My admin account can view AD and GPOs, but not DNS so i was unable to pre-determine if they even exist currently or not.

-Anthony Romero

short_description: Please register DNS for SendGrid
description:
We will be using SendGrid to send mass emails; Paul Liderman sais we need a dedicated IP from them, but SendGrid requires us to set up DNS entries for verification before they can give us an IP. Paul Liderman mentions to put in a ticket and make him "approver" (I don't know how to add him as approver).

Below are the instructions from the verdor"
Here's the main steps for the DNS update: 

1.	In the SendGrid UI, select Settings > Sender Authentication.
2.	In the domain authentication section, click Get Started.
3.	Next, add in information about your DNS host, and indicate whether you also want to set up link branding. Click Next. For more information about link branding, check out What is link branding?.
4.	Fill in the domain that you want to send from and add advanced settings as needed. Make sure that you only enter the name of your root domain. Do not include www or http://www in this field. Your domain needs to match the domain of your FROM address on the emails you are sending out. For example, if I am sending an email from example@sendgrid.com, I would set my domain authentication domain to be sendgrid.com. Click Next. For more information about advanced settings, see Advanced settings.
5.	Next, you need to add all of the CNAME records on this screen to your DNS host. This process varies depending on your DNS host. For videos on how to add your CNAME to some popular DNS service providers, check out these videos. If you don't have access to modify your companies DNS records, you can also email a request to a co-worker. This email includes a direct link to the CNAME records. This link does expire. The recipient doesn't need login access to your SendGrid account.

Once you add the CNAME records to your DNS host, return to the Sender authentication page and click Verify.

short_description: Setting Up Subdomains for SBDEO Challenge Portal (Vendor is Ready.net)
description:
OCTO's State Broadband and Digital Equity Office (SBDEO) is working with the vendor Ready.net to set up a challenge portal for our external stakeholders to access. Below are the details from the vendor:

Initial record below as the first step for verification - after it’s on place, we’ll be able to create more records that will do the pointing.
 
Host:
broadband.dc.gov
Value:
google-site-verification=3TOE0r-5PEc1mbGh3smScfwQ9DfvgZyTz98LlR3MvZ8

The licensed capabilities include a set of web applications hosted, maintained, deployed and monitored via Google App Engine (GAE). We have found that engagement is most successful when our applications are behind a .gov domain. So we request your assistance establishing the following subdomains:

register.broadband.dc.gov
challenge.broadband.dc.gov
staging.challenge.broadband.dc.gov
dev.challenge.broadband.dc.gov
To accomplish this, GAE first requires a simple TXT record to be placed as high up on the root domain as possible, specifically to verify that the domain is indeed authorized for us to use. This record will primarily be used to generate TLS (SSL) certificates, as well as some internal verification that happens in the background. It’s required that this TXT record remain in DNS throughout the duration of our application’s uptime, as removal of it may trigger Google’s revocation of TLS certificates. In terms of DNS CAA trust information, our certificates are issued by Google Trust Services LLC https://pki.goog/

We would typically recommend that this TXT record is placed at broadband.dc.gov, to cover all subdomains for our applications.

A future set of records will actually point to our applications, and they would have their origin at subdomains of your choice and point to a place in GAE that we cannot predict before we verify the domain. These records may be either CNAME or A/AAAA records - as stated, we will be able to provide more information after verification.

Secondly, our application featureset involves sending no-reply emails from a white-labeled email address. To simplify this process, many clients prefer utilizing our integration with the mailer service SendGrid to send spoofed emails on the state's behalf with a high degree of deliverability and reliability. To accomplish this, we generate a set of CNAME and TXT records related to SendGrid, to be added to your DNS as well. These records would act as DKIM, SPF, and DMARC records to verify that SendGrid is allowed to send emails from the .gov domain that is chosen. We would typically recommend an address such as:

no-reply@broadband.dc.gov

Finally, we’ve encountered some issues with firewalls in other state clients - we would like to check that internal firewalls will allow web traffic when state employees are accessing it from an internal network.  We are happy to provide a complete list of domains that our web apps use if needed for whitelisting purposes as well.

If these subdomains, email address, and general approach are all agreeable, we will generate and forward the TXT record as the first step in the process. If there are any concerns, we are happy to sync on those details, and work out a plan.

short_description: Request to Add DKIM (2048-bit) CNAME Records for dc.gov – DGS Salesforce
description:
DGS is requesting assistance adding DKIM DNS records for the domain dc.gov to support Salesforce outbound email signing.

Salesforce will enforce mandatory domain-level verification beginning in Spring ’26. To ensure uninterrupted delivery of system-generated emails (workflow notifications, approvals, work order alerts, etc.), we must enable DKIM for dc.gov using a 2048-bit key.
Below are the required DNS entries generated by Salesforce:
CNAME Record 1
Host/Name: dcgov._domainkey.dc.gov
Type: CNAME
Target/Value: dcgov.296pn1.custdkim.salesforce.com
CNAME Record: dcgov._domainkey.dc.gov IN CNAME dcgov.296pn1.custdkim.salesforce.com.
CNAME Record 2
Host/Name: dcgov2._domainkey.dc.gov
Type: CNAME
Target/Value: dcgov2.m8nbuh.custdkim.salesforce.com
CANME Record: dcgov2._domainkey.dc.gov IN CNAME dcgov2.m8nbuh.custdkim.salesforce.com.
Important Notes:
• Record type must be CNAME (not TXT)
• Records must be added to public DNS
• No quotes should be included in the value
• DNS entries are not case-sensitive
• Please ensure there are no trailing periods automatically appended unless required by DNS standards
Once these records are published and propagated, Salesforce will automatically validate the DKIM keys and allow activation.
Please let me know:
1.	If a change request or an additional submission is required
2.	Estimated timeline for DNS publication
3.	If any additional technical documentation is needed

The Salesforce enforcement deadline (Production: April 27, 2026) is to prevent disruption to outbound email delivery from Salesforce.

short_description: Prod InfoBlox Service Account for ECIS BAP Project.
description:
Hello Team,

As part of the ECIS Self Service BAP Project, We want Prod InfoBlox Service Account to manage the IP Addresses, and hostnames registry in Infoblox for the VMs that are provisioned via BAP project. There is a test account created for the same bap.test.infoblox.svc.

The Service Account name, we want for Prod rollout is : bap.infoblox.svc.

Below set of permissions are needed:

Category, Permission
DNS, Read Zones
DNS, Add Host Records
DNS, Modify Host Records
DNS, Delete Host Records
DHCP, Create Fixed Address
DHCP, Modify Fixed Address
DHCP, Read DHCP Ranges
IPAM, Read Networks
IPAM, Read IP Address Objects
IPAM, Allocate Available IP
EA, Read Extensible Attributes
EA, Write Extensible Attributes
Security, API Access Enabled
User Role - Which gives read-only access


Additional details for your reference for the work that we have done for your review :

We now have the non-prod server request workflow online. It is available for anyone in ECIS to try out at the links below. The backend code is available at https://github.in.dc.gov/jamestate/terraform-action-test/tree/nonprod. This repo does not have a detailed README yet but I'm happy to go into detail about it all in call/meeting sometime. I'll get to the documentation later this week. We are still working on the separate request workflow for an IP address / DNS name only – you'll see the backend for that request in this repo, but it is not available for testing in non-prod Service-Now yet.
 
We also have the Infoblox "used addresses reservation import script" developed and tested. You can see that code in the separate repo at https://github.in.dc.gov/jamestate/ipam-import. This script was tested with data files provided by DCNET and the lab Infoblox instance. By default it is a "dry-run" – only reading from Infoblox and reporting on how many records it needs to create.
 
Please let us know your thoughts on moving to production testing with the production Infoblox instance. We have not yet requested the production Infoblox user as we're waiting for your feedback on the non-prod services. We do already have a 'bap.test.infoblox.svc' user on the production Infoblox that we are not currently using.

description:
Please Update Veritas NetBackup  to latest version for GIS server  gisagsprdsvr09(10.82.20.129 ) by this Wednesday.

The follow VA scan report requires us to make this upgrade:

175434 - Veritas NetBackup prior to 10.0 Privilege Escalation (VTS23-006)
Synopsis
A back-up management application installed on the remote host is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
Description
The Veritas NetBackup application installed on the remote Windows host is prior to 10.0 or is missing a vendorsupplied
security hotfix. It is, therefore, affected by privilege escalation vulnerability. An issue was discovered in
Veritas NetBackup before 10.0. A vulnerability in the way NetBackup validates the path to a DLL prior to loading may
allow a lower level user to elevate privileges and compromise the system.
Note that Nessus has not tested for this issue but has instead relied only on the application's self-reported version
See Also
https://www.veritas.com/content/support/en_US/security/VTS23-006
http://www.nessus.org/u?77f64edb
http://www.nessus.org/u?dcbf9da1
http://www.nessus.org/u?2e9e0740
http://www.nessus.org/u?8d1058ca
Solution
Upgrade to Veritas NetBackup version 10.0 or later or apply the appropriate EEB or hotfix.
Risk Factor
Medium

Finding Details:
========================================
Finding ID: A.1
	
Finding Details: The agency does not conduct a semi-annual inventory of removable media containing FTI.
(Moderate)
The backup tapes stored at DC1 are not inventoried semi-annually. The agency is required to conduct semi-annual inventories of removable media containing FTI. 
The agency must account for any missing electronic media; document search efforts taken and notify the appropriate authorities of the loss as directed in Publication 1075. See Publication 1075 sections 1.8 and 2.B.5.
	
Recommended Remediation: The agency must conduct a semi-annual inventory of removable media containing FTI. The targeted implementation date for this recommendation is 9 months from the date of the closing conference.

We hereby request for any evidence that the inventorying of removable media containing FTI from a DCAS perspective have been conducted withing the last six (6) months.

Thank you.

Related to Ticket: UR0632884 and UR0632357- Details below. 

CWITS completed the firewall updates to enable access to the database. However, after signing in no tables are visible. The team needs read only access to the tables (see attached image).  

----------------- Second Request ----------------------

Related to Ticket: UR0632357 - Details below. Sergey Dementyev directed us to open a ticket with CWITS to update the firewall as follows: 

Firewall needs to be opened for IP range 10.82.47.120-126 on port 1762 from Oracle Client Server IP running on 10.87.73.131. If possible, also allow traffic from Oracle Client Server IP running on VPN connected clients (164.82.32.13, 164.82.1.13). 

------------------- Original Request --------------------


The DLCP CorpOnline Replacement Team needs access to OCTO's FileNet database which stores CorpOnline documentation. Access to the following was provided on 5/2/2025: 

Hostname: dc2oraprd7.dc.gov
Port:1762
servicename: fnprd.dc.gov

After over a week of troubleshooting the team still cannot connect to the database. The FileNet team has suggested that it may be some listener or firewall issue which will require support from the server side by the OCTO Server team. The following provides excerpts from a Teams troubleshooting group chat

------------- Teams Chat ---------------------- 
From: Papadopulos2, Stephan, Monday 5:43 PM
Sharma, Anup (OCTO) - we have been trying to connect to the Docversion table for DLCP FileNet Prod. We appear to be connecting to the server, but the credentials are failing. Can you please double check that the user and PW you emailed on Friday are correct?

Sharma, Anup (OCTO) - if they are using their local machines, there are different types.

2. If the are connected to VPN using ZScaler, then the firewall should be opened for the source of the user's email using zscaler profile. In case of zscaler, sometimes the local ip shows as 192.168.x.x which is not something they can open the firewall from.

For servers also the Dynamic IP settings will make the firewall permission invalid once the IP gets refreshed. They need to ask to get a static IP for the Prod Server so it won't change and we don't have to change/update FW request.

short_description: The server refuse to send an email from the FRSP Guide application on Production (10.87.9.21).
description:
When a user at the FRSP guide goes to the Forgot Password page (https://frspguide.dhs.dc.gov/Identity/Account/ForgotPassword), puts in their email, and clicks on the Submit button, nothing happens; when it should be showing a page saying to "Please check your email to reset your password."

I checked at the logs for the site and found out that the server is rejecting the request.  This is what I got on the log:

2022-06-27T13:49:17.1857221-04:00 [ERR] () Error in SendEmailAsync(): Failure sending mail. 
InnerException: - System.Net.Internals.SocketExceptionFactory+ExtendedSocketException (10061): No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it. [::ffff:127.0.0.1]:587
   at System.Net.Sockets.Socket.DoConnect(EndPoint endPointSnapshot, SocketAddress socketAddress)

This is unusual. The website hasn't been updated for a while, and I never ran into this problem until recently.

On my appsettings.Production.json page, this is the email setup:

  "EmailSettings": {
    "MailServer": "localhost",
    "MailPort": 587,
    "SenderName": "FRSP Resource",
    "Sender": "frsp_resource@dc.gov",
    "Password": "some_password",
    "Secure": true
  }

Has this been changed for production servers?

Production server: DHSBENSQLPRD
IP address: 10.87.9.21

And I know that it's a production server thing, because on the test site for FRSP Guide (https://frspguide.in.dc.gov/Identity/Account/ForgotPasswordConfirmation), it works fine, even with the same email setup and it's basically the same code as the one on production:

  "EmailSettings": {
    "MailServer": "localhost",
    "MailPort": 587,
    "SenderName": "FRSP Resource",
    "Sender": "frsp_resource@dc.gov",
    "Password": "some_password",
    "Secure": true
  }

short_description: DLCP Team Needs Access to Hostname: dc2oraprd7.dc.gov
description:
The DLCP CorpOnline Replacement Team needs access to OCTO's FileNet database which stores CorpOnline documentation. Access to the following was provided on 5/2/2025: 

Hostname: dc2oraprd7.dc.gov
Port:1762
servicename: fnprd.dc.gov

After over a week of troubleshooting the team still cannot connect to the database. The FileNet team has suggested that it may be some listener or firewall issue which will require support from the server side by the OCTO Server team. The following provides excerpts from a Teams troubleshooting group chat

------------- Teams Chat ---------------------- 
From: Papadopulos2, Stephan, Monday 5:43 PM
Sharma, Anup (OCTO) - we have been trying to connect to the Docversion table for DLCP FileNet Prod. We appear to be connecting to the server, but the credentials are failing. Can you please double check that the user and PW you emailed on Friday are correct? 
 
Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB), Tuesday 9:21 AM 
Dang, Thu (DCRA-Contractor) - can you please add the screenshot of the error you are getting? 

Dang, Thu (DLCP-Contractor), Tuesday 9:21 AM 
 <Image Added | Status : Failure-Test failed: ORA-17002:I/O error: Socket read interrupted, Authentication lapse 0 ms:https://docs.oracle.com/error-help/db/ora-1...>

Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB), Tuesday 9:24 AM 
Sharma, Anup (OCTO), Abbineni, Siva (OCTO-Contractor), and Duraisamy, Nathan (OCTO-Contractor) - please let us know if  you have any suggestions. 
 
Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB), Wednesday 11:54 AM 
Sharma, Anup (OCTO) - following up on your email from yesterday. When do you think you or your team will have a moment to look into our access issue? Could we have an incorrect username or pwd? 
 
Sharma, Anup (OCTO), Wednesday 12:29 PM
Hi Stephan, how are you connecting and also you would need to connect from your prod corp server. I tested using sqlplus and was able to connect

Sharma, Anup (OCTO), Wednesday 12:29 PM
It could be firewall. It should work with sqldeveloper

Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB), Wednesday 12:33 PM  
I understand our team was using the Oracle Client to connect from their PCs while on VPN. Roberts, Doug (DOB-Contractor) or Dang, Thu (DLCP-Contractor) - please respond with details.

Dang, Thu (DLCP-Contractor), Wednesday 12:35 PM 
That is correct, I was using my local laptop on the GlobalProtect VPN to connect via SQLDeveloper 
 
Does it specifically need to be a production server or can it be any corp server? 

Sharma, Anup (OCTO), Wednesday 12:37 PM 
As long as the firewall is open form that server to the FileNet DB server , test using telnet if port is open
 
Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB), Wednesday 1:10 PM  
My understanding is that Doug was able to Telnet to that port from his pc.
 
Duraisamy, Nathan (OCTO-Contractor), Wednesday 1:11 PM
Sharma, Anup (OCTO) - if they are using their local machines, there are different types. 

1. If they are connected to LAN/Secured Wifi , then they need the IP of their machines as source
2. If the are connected to VPN using ZScaler, then the firewall should be opened for the source of the user's email using zscaler profile. In case of zscaler, sometimes the local ip shows as 192.168.x.x which is not something they can open the firewall from.

For servers also the Dynamic IP settings will make the firewall permission invalid once the IP gets refreshed. They need to ask to get a static IP for the Prod Server so it won't change and we don't have to change/update FW request.
 
        Responding to: Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB)
        My understanding is that Doug was able to Telnet to that port from his pc.
Telnet may confirm that the Route from the source machine to Destination exists. But the firewall may block the machine 
accessing to DB server on other ports.
 
For Oracle, there must be an explicit "Allow" rule must be added from your machines to the DB server or it's subnet on Port 1521 or 1522. These are the default Oracle DB ports like 1433 for SQL Server. Otherwise connections will be denied.
 
Roberts, Doug (DOB-Contractor), Wednesday 1:29 PM
Just to clarify, I was able from my local machine using global protect to connect to the server on the port you specified using telnet.  Also using the oracle developer extension for VS code, If I entered the connection information as you stated it never rejected the connection, just didn't connect.  But if I changed the service name, it gave me an error that the incorrect service did not exist on that server.
 
Duraisamy, Nathan (OCTO-Contractor), Wednesday 1:32 PM
Makes sense about the nature of connection. Anup may be able to verify if the name is correct based on what’s created in that server
 
Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB), Wednesday 2:52 PM  
Doug will try connecting from one of our ECIS-hosted servers to see if there's any difference. In the meantime, can you please confirm that the credentials email on Friday at 4:20 PM are correct?
 
Roberts, Doug (DOB-Contractor), Wednesday 3:21 PM
I get this error with jdeveloper from the server 
<Image Provided | Status : Failure - Test failed: ORA-12541: Cannot connect. No listener at host dc2oraprd7.dc.gov port 1762. (CONNECTION_ID=fsJakZbaT6Wu0j0Q...> 

Duraisamy, Nathan (OCTO-Contractor), Wednesday 3:23 PM
Could you check with port 1521?
 
Roberts, Doug (DOB-Contractor), Wednesday 3:24 PM
same error but it changed port to 1521
 
Duraisamy, Nathan (OCTO-Contractor), Wednesday 3:24 PM
How about 1522

Roberts, Doug (DOB-Contractor), Wednesday 3:25 PM 
same thing

Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB), Thursday 10:00 AM   
Team - what's the status on this access? Is there something else we need to try? Have the credentials been confirmed?

Duraisamy, Nathan (OCTO-Contractor), Thursday 10:04 AM 
It looks like some listener issue or firewall which we need support on the server side. We need to check with OCTO Server team. Sharma, Anup (OCTO)
 
Papadopulos2, Stephan (DOB), Today 10:00 AM

short_description: Moving Spotlight documents to a test server
description:
Good afternoon Hardik, 

I was wondering if we could meet on a task we need to have done. This is a semi annual task that Emmanuel completed in the fall. Now we need the spring documents uploaded. 
 
There is already a  CR in our system. I need it to be processed because it was marked as a duplicate in the Fall which really was not a duplicate. The business owner just put both semi-annual tasks in at one time. I was not prepared for that level of efficiency!! 
 
 
It looks like Cyrus shared the files with you via Google.
 
 
 
The one difference this time is the file size. This time the English version file is almost 10G and the LOTE versions are almost 2G.  I know Ben (our old developer) used to have to be patient with downloading and transferring files of that size so I wanted to give you a heads up.  
 
Since we are not recoding anything I feel fairly confident that the procedure on our side will be fine, but I'd like to run it in either Nightly (10.87.2.93) or Test 2 (10.87.4.34).  under the file path: /usr/fsc/tool-staging/x2sis/import/Spotlight/***PDF files***. 
 
I'd prefer nightly, but I think Emmanuel had a challenge with that because the "Spotlight" folder did not exist in Nightly when I asked about it in the fall.  
 
It will be the same file path when we move to prod: 10.87.2.31
 
We probably should work to get these tasks done by end of next week if possible. I am going to talk to my team to see if I can get this one on CAB this week (though it is late in the game for that). 
 
Let me know if there are any questions,
 
Thanks, 
D

short_description: Receiving error on server see attached remedy from esri ( downgrade vm tools to 12.4) 	 DDOTGISDEMO01 IP 10.83.49.196
description:
See remedy from esri support 

Error Message
Customers have been reporting that ArcGIS Enterprise print services, default or custom, unexpectedly crash when VMWare Tools 12.5 is installed on the same machine as the ArcGIS Server component. When investigating, users may see the following messages in the ArcGIS Server logs:

<Msg time="2024-10-30T13:51:40,397" type="SEVERE" code="9000" source="Rest" process="1360" thread="1" methodName="" machine="xyz.com" user="" admin="" requestID="18e643d2-02cd-46d1-89d4-9e1704a2c92a">Error performing execute operation Error handling service request :Could not service request.</Msg>
<Msg time="2024-10-30T14:04:15,311" type="SEVERE" code="7551" source="Server" process="1360" thread="26" methodName="" machine=" xyz.com " user="" admin ="" requestID="a868451b-3ec3-4e7e-8d15-ba57d267ae2d">Instance of the service 'Test/ExportWebMap.GPServer' crashed. Please see if an error report was generated in 'D:\arcgisserver\logs\</Msg>
<Msg time="2024-10-30T14:04:26,607" type="SEVERE" code="7553" source="Server" process="1360" thread="26" methodName="" machine=" xyz.com " user="" admin ="" requestID="a868451b-3ec3-4e7e-8d15-ba57d267ae2d">The containing process for 'Test/ExportWebMap' job 'j684cfa28396b441999c4e9b3130cf09c' has crashed.</Msg>
There have also been reports of the caching controller crashing.

This knowledge article describes the nature of the error as well as two options to resolve it.


Cause
The cause of this issue is a known VMWare defect involving the vm3dgl64.dll file used by the OpenGL driver packaged with VMware Tools 12.5.0. Process Monitor logs report that vm3dgl64.dll receives many read requests from the ArcSOC.exe process that manages the PrintingTools service just before it crashes. vm3dgl64.dll is a commonly distributed library with VMWare tools that interfaces with many applications, including ArcGIS Server.

Solution or Workaround
There are two possible solutions for this issue:

Roll back to VMWare Tools 12.4.5 until a newer version is released. As users report, this has been the most common and simplest solution to avoid the crash.
Implement one of the workarounds developed by the owners of VMWare, Broadcom. The workarounds, as described in their knowledge base, include:
Disable the use of llvmpipe by adding this virtual machine config option to the VM's VMX file: guestinfo.svga.disableLLVMPipe=TRUE
Set a system environment variable SVGA_ALLOW_LLVMPIPE=0

Synopsis
A driver management application installed on the remote Windows host is affected by multiple vulnerabilities

therefore, affected by multiple vulnerabilities:
- Due to an uncontrolled search path element, an authenticated, local attacker can elevate their privileges.
(CVE-2023-28388, CVE-2024-21814)
Note that Nessus has not tested for these issues but has instead relied only on the application's self-reported version
number.
See Also
http://www.nessus.org/u?5ecbc9ca
http://www.nessus.org/u?1d63a61d

Upgrade to Intel Chipset Device Software version 10.1.19444.8378 or later.

short_description: Add prod vCenter access for ECIS BAP service account

We have a service user in AD named `bap.prov.vc.svc`. This is the user GitHub Actions and Terraform will use to login to prod vCenter from the provisioning automation server (ecis-bap-provisioning - 10.86.49.187). This user already exists in AD and has a password set. But it does not yet have privileges in prod vCenter. Please allow this user to authenticate to prod vCenter and give it the same role used for the non-prod user in the lab vCenter. This role needs to be applied recursively from the root vCenter objects to get the correct permissions on the compute clusters, datastore clusters, etc.

In "octolab vCenter" we have a role called "VM Provision and Create Folders". This role includes all the necessary privileges for creating and managing VMs throughout their lifecycle, and it allows creating new folders in the datastores for when a new agency gets a VM. The `bap.test.prov.vc.svc` user has this role applied recursively from the vCenter to all child objects.

James Borris advised I submit this request, after which he will discuss with the engineers.

Thanks,

James

short_description: US bank SFTP transfer for DOES and upgrading Ciphers checking
description:
DOES need to comply with US Bank's latest SFTP/SSH security CIPHERS. Is Octo's SFTP host, ent-sftp.dc.gov, updated with the ciphers? See below.

SFTP Server Security Update: CBC Ciphers Discontinuation & RSA-SSH Key Algorithm Replacement 
 
Valued Partner, 
 
We are committed to ensuring the highest level of security for our systems and your data. As part of our ongoing security enhancements, we will be removing support for CBC (Cipher Block Chaining) ciphers/algorithms in our SFTP server, effective June 03, 2025. Additionally, we will be replacing our RSA-SSH server key algorithm with SSH-ED25519. 
 
Action may be Required 
If your SFTP client or system is currently configured to use CBC-mode ciphers or RSA-based SSH key authentication, you will need to update your settings by June 02, 2025, to use more secure ciphers and ensure support for SSH-ED25519. We recommend verifying your SFTP configurations now and making necessary adjustments before the enforcement date to avoid any disruptions.  Supported ciphers and details are provided at the bottom of this email. 
 
If you need to make changes for these security upgrades, they must be in place by June 2, 2025, or you will not be able to access the U.S. Bank/FSV SFTP site.   
 
Why Is This Change Necessary? 
CBC-mode ciphers are considered weak and may be vulnerable to certain cryptographic attacks. These vulnerabilities can potentially be exploited to compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data transmissions. To enhance security and align with industry best practices, we are removing these outdated ciphers in favor of more secure encryption methods.  
 
Similarly, RSA-based SSH keys are increasingly being replaced with more modern algorithms due to concerns about key length and computational efficiency. We are transitioning to SSH-ED25519, which offers stronger security, better performance, and is required for Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance. 
 
Details for your SFTP/IT teams and partners: 
Please verify you are already using the supported ciphers listed below.  If you are not already using the supported SFTP ciphers below, make arrangements to update before June 2nd .

short_description: Resources for using Azure cloud services for OCTO/agencies
description:
There are currently no resources to help explain and onboard agencies to Azure cloud services under the DC Government tenant that OCTO's ECIS team manages. This is necessary as we transition to the cloud. Without a transition strategy that is known across OCTO divisions and well-communicated to agencies, there is already a lot of confusion. 

If we want to avoid agencies purchasing their own cloud licenses, there needs to be robust, up-to-date, widely available and known instructions and documentation about who to contact and how to securely use these resources. It is not exclusively agency IT teams who may need to use these services. For example, agency program data teams will ask for help getting access to the data and compute resources in Azure. Even as the OCTO's Azure cloud data exchange initiative becomes available, there will also need to be awareness - in both documentation and training (again, not exclusively for agency IT teams) - to accompany it. 

Note, that there are more than just data tools on Azure, including web-publishing services, API services, networking, file storage, etc. Which means that it will be important to work closely with agencies around how they can strategically leverage Azure to improve agency operations. Even at OCTO, many internal staff who could be using these tools are not aware of how to do so. This highlights the need for better communications strategy/plan for Azure cloud services.
